title: Measure rider sag and adjust stock spring preload

applicability.included: Exact standard US 2021 Yamaha YZ450F with original stock suspension.
excluded: Changed springs, revalving or replacement suspension

entry_state: Assembled bike with identified, serviceable stock suspension.
exit_state: Stock baseline or measured rider sag recorded; no internal overhaul performed.
preflight: Identify the exact bike and stock components. Save starting settings.
critical_stop_conditions: Unidentified adjuster or inability to reach a setting without force

source.review_note: Root author/source review and independent year_groups_research review accepted bounded setup. 2020 copyright locator corrected to4; no mechanical changes after review.

steps.title: Check the shock and access
steps.instruction: Check the shock and linkage for leaks, damage or binding before measuring. Clean dirt from the spring rings. The assembled-bike route requires access to both rings without removing other parts; stop if extra access work is needed.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Measure fully extended length
steps.instruction: Securely raise the rear wheel clear of the ground. Measure A from the rear axle center to the rear fender holding bolt; record the two exact measuring points and length.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Measure rider-loaded length
steps.instruction: Remove the stand and have a helper balance the bike while the rider sits astride the seat. Measure B between the same axle center and rear fender holding bolt. Record B and calculate rider sag as A minus B; the manual target is 90–100 mm.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Establish spring free length
steps.instruction: Raise the rear wheel securely again. Loosen the spring locknut and back off the adjusting ring until a small clearance opens above the spring. Measure and record its unloaded free length. Do not turn the ring beyond its usable range.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Adjust within the spring range
steps.instruction: Turn the adjusting ring to compress the spring relative to the measured free length. The stock starting preload is 7 mm; permitted preload is 1.5–18.0 mm. One ring turn changes installed length by 1.5 mm. Increase preload to reduce rider sag, or decrease it to increase sag; keep the spring within the permitted range.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Lock and remeasure
steps.instruction: Tighten the locknut against the adjusting ring. Repeat A with the rear wheel raised, then lower the bike securely for rider-loaded B. Repeat adjustment and these two measurements until rider sag is within 90–100 mm. Record free length, final installed length, preload and sag. If the target cannot be reached within the allowed range, obtain the appropriate spring; do not force more adjustment.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Confirm the result
steps.instruction: Confirm the locknut is secure and the suspension moves smoothly. Save the actual settings and recheck sag after break-in or spring settling. This guide does not cover spring replacement or shock internals.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

completeness: Assembled-bike original spring sag and preload adjustment; ring access required; no spring replacement or internal service.
